description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified network domain
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-network-domain --instance-id bastionhost-cn-i7m2btk6g48 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-domain-id 3 --check-proxy-state false --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetNetworkDomain

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to get this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

For more information about region IDs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。

Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the network domain to query.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html operation to get this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的网络域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: network_domain_id

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to immediately recheck the status of the proxy server. Valid values:

true: Immediately rechecks the status of the proxy server and returns the latest ProxyState and ProxyStateErrorCode.

false: (Default) Returns the currently recorded status without rechecking the proxy server
parameters.help_zh:
是否立即重新检测代理服务器状态。取值：

true：立即重新检测代理服务器状态并返回最新的 ProxyState/ProxyStateErrorCode。

false：默认取值。不重新检测代理服务器状态，直接返回当前记录的状态
parameters.name: check_proxy_state
